policy: Every KEA display-source row is preserved. Multiple exact candidates are never arbitrarily selected: only a shared non-null displacement may be inherited. Cosmetic displacement-only joins may ignore only explicit model-year markers, built-in-camera text, or Step2 text. A containment-only displacement join is allowed only under the documented unique-match rules. Missing displacement may also be filled by a reviewed official manufacturer rule whose maker, anchored current-generation engine pattern, and propulsion all match. Existing KEA displacement is never replaced. No SEO/public state is inferred.
